data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Anatole, meaning 'sunrise' or 'rising up'. This name was given to girls in ancient Greece, signifying a new beginning or a fresh start. The name Anatola carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anatola usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anatola total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

This name was given to babies born at the beginning of a new day, thereby symbolizing the hope and promise of a new life. Additionally, in various Christian cultures, the name Anatola could also represent the journey of saints or spiritual pilgrims towards the East, towards the rising sun and the presence of God.
